theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_difference_quotient_limit
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (x₀ e : Rn n) (ρ δ M : ℝ), 0 < α → α ≤ 1 → 0 < δ → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f (ball x₀ (ρ + δ * ‖e‖)) → (∀ d : ℝ, d ≠ 0 → |d| < δ → ∀ x ∈ ball x₀ ρ, ‖d⁻¹ • (fderiv ℝ f (x + d • e) - fderiv ℝ f x)‖ ≤ M) → (∀ d : ℝ, d ≠ 0 → |d| < δ → ∀ x ∈ ball x₀ ρ, ∀ y ∈ ball x₀ ρ, ‖d⁻¹ • (fderiv ℝ f (x + d • e) - fderiv ℝ f x) - d⁻¹ • (fderiv ℝ f (y + d • e) - fderiv ℝ f y)‖ ≤ M * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => fderiv ℝ f x e) (ball x₀ ρ) ∧ (∀ x ∈ ball x₀ ρ, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z e) x‖ ≤ M) ∧ ∀ x ∈ ball x₀ ρ, ∀ y ∈ ball x₀ ρ, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z e) x - fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z e) y‖ ≤ M * ‖x - y‖ ^ α
